newsitem.title: USA: Encore Wire stake raised by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Encore Wire stake raised by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by Boston investor Jeffrey Vinik said Thursday it raised it stake in Encore Wire Corp to 637,000 common shares or nine percent from 7.9 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 78,200 common shares between February 21 and Feburary 26 at prices ranging from $19.50 to $22.27 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
The McKinney, Texas-based company is a low-cost manufacturer of copper electrical wire for commercial, industrial and residential use.
